source.author: verg
source.text: Talis prima Dares caput altum in proelia tollit, ostenditque umeros latos, alternaque iactat brachia protendens, et verberat ictibus auras.
source.text_original: Talis prima Dares caput altum in proelia tollit, / ostenditque umeros latos, alternaque iactat / brachia protendens, et verberat ictibus auras.
source.text_english: Thus first Dares lifts his high head into battle, displays his broad shoulders, and, stretching out his arms in turn, brandishes them and strikes the air with blows.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at tibi collectas solvit iam fibula vestes ostenditque umeros fortes spatiumque superbi pectoris Herculeis aequum, Meleagre, lacertis.
reuse.text_original: at tibi collectas solvit iam fibula vestes / ostenditque umeros fortes spatiumque superbi / pectoris Herculeis aequum, Meleagre, lacertis.
reuse.text_english: But for you the buckle now loosens the gathered garments and reveals your strong shoulders and the expanse of your proud chest, equal to Hercules’ arms, Meleager.
